facts.fact: NewsDay reports the first operational section, Plumtree-Bulawayo, of the Powertel-Paratus Zimbabwe fibre corridor to Botswana is live and carrying traffic at 800Gbps initial capacity.
NewsDay reports the second phase, extending the corridor from Bulawayo to Livingstone in Zambia, is under construction and expected to be commissioned in September 2026.

NewsDay reports the project runs under a public-private partnership signed in June 2025 with Paratus, plus an Indefeasible Right of Use agreement giving Paratus capacity while Powertel keeps operational control.

systems.owner: Powertel Communications (ZESA subsidiary) with Paratus Zimbabwe under an IRU
